{{Short description|Altmetrics company; part of Elsevier}}
'''Plum Analytics''' was a [[Philadelphia]], [[Pennsylvania]]-based [[altmetrics]] company dedicated to measuring the influence of scientific research. 

== History ==
It was founded in 2011 by Andrea Michalek, who served as President of the company until 2019, and Mike Buschman. Michalek and Buschman met in the product development team at [[Serials Solutions]], which was subsequently integrated into [[ProQuest]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Carpenter |first=Todd A. |date=2017-02-02 |title=Plum Goes Orange – Elsevier Acquires Plum Analytics |url=https://scholarlykitchen.sspnet.org/2017/02/02/plum-goes-orange-elsevier-acquires-plum-analytics/ |access-date=2026-09-12 |website=The Scholarly Kitchen |language=en-US}}</ref>.

Plum Analytics was acquired by [[EBSCO Information Services]] for an undisclosed amount in 2014<ref>{{Cite web |last=Enis |first=Matt |title=EBSCO Acquires Altmetrics Provider Plum Analytics |url=https://www.libraryjournal.com/story/ebsco-acquires-altmetrics-provider-plum-analytics |access-date=2026-09-12 |website=Library Journal}}</ref>, then later sold to [[Elsevier]] in February 2017 <ref>{{Cite web |url=https://seekingalpha.com/article/4043343-elsevier-acquires-plum-analytics-measure-research-performance |title=Elsevier Acquires Plum Analytics To Measure Research Performance |last=Jones |first=Donovan |date=2017-02-07 |website=Seeking Alpha}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Elsevier acquires Plum Analytics |website=Research Information |date=2 February 2017 |url=https://www.researchinformation.info/news/elsevier-acquires-plum-analytics |access-date=2018-06-01}}</ref>. Its metrics were incorporated into Elsevier's existing products, including [[Mendeley]] and [[Scopus]]<ref>{{Cite press release |title=Elsevier Acquires Leading 'Altmetrics' Provider Plum Analytics |date=2017-02-02 |url=https://www.elsevier.com/about/press-releases/corporate/elsevier-acquires-leading-altmetrics-provider-plum-analytics |language=en |access-date=2018-02-25 |website=Elsevier}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://campustechnology.com/articles/2017/02/03/elsevier-continues-to-expand-journal-analytics-through-acquisition.aspx |title=Elsevier Continues to Expand Journal Analytics Through Acquisition  |date=2017-02-03 |website=Campus Technology |language=en |access-date=2018-02-25}}</ref>.

==Product and services==

=== PlumX ===
Plum Analytics is best known for '''PlumX''', which was the company's first product. PlumX is an online tool that provides altmetrics for peer-reviewed journal articles and other scholarly works <ref>{{Cite journal |last=Champieux |first=Robin |date=January 2015 |title=PlumX |journal=Journal of the Medical Library Association |volume=103 |issue=1 |pages=63–64 |doi=10.3163/1536-5050.103.1.019 |pmc=4279944}}</ref> by aggregating information from different sources including Wikipedia, [[Mendeley]] (for bookmarks and downloads), the [[United States Patent and Trademark Office|USPTO]] (for patents), [[Social Science Research Network|SSRN]] (for citation and usage data), [[Facebook]] (for shares and [[Facebook like button|Likes]]), Lexis-Nexis Metabase (for news) and Overton.io (for government policy citations)<ref>{{Cite web |title=PlumX Metrics for research impact stories {{!}} Elsevier |url=https://www.elsevier.com/en-gb/insights/metrics/plumx |access-date=2026-09-12 |website=www.elsevier.com |language=en-gb}}</ref>.

In August 2015, Plum Analytics released the "PlumX Suite", which consists of five separate products: Metrics, Dashboards, +Grants, Benchmarks, and Funding Opportunities<ref>{{Cite press release |title=PlumX Suite Now Available from Plum™ Analytics |date=2015-08-03 |url=https://plumanalytics.com/press/plumx-suite-now-available-from-plum-analytics/ |language=en-US |access-date=2018-10-17 |website=Plum Analytics}}</ref>. These were discountined once the company was acquired by Elsever, and PlumX data is now available primarily through badges on Scopus, Mendeley and institutional repositories<ref>{{Cite web |title=Integrate PlumX |url=https://www.elsevier.com/en-gb/insights/metrics/plumx/integrate |access-date=2026-09-12 |website=www.elsevier.com |language=en-gb}}</ref>.
